metadata.title: DEMO / SYNTHETIC KNOWLEDGE BASE
metadata.description: Synthetic reference knowledge base for 15 standard DOTA object categories created for college RAG project demonstration.
metadata.warning: This document contains synthetic/dummy information created purely for demonstrating the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture.

plane.title: Plane Category Profile
plane.description: Fixed-wing aircraft including commercial airliners, cargo transports, and military aircraft visible in aerial imagery.
plane.key_characteristics: Planes feature distinctive swept wings, a elongated fuselage, horizontal/vertical tail stabilizers, and shadow projections. They are predominantly found on runways, taxiways, aprons, and open tarmac areas at airports or airfields.
plane.tactical_and_operational_context: In satellite and aerial intelligence, aircraft count and spatial layout reflect logistical throughput, operational status of airfields, and strategic deployment levels. Fixed-wing aircraft require substantial runway infrastructure compared to rotary-wing aircraft.
plane.detection_and_resolution_notes: Planes exhibit high contrast against dark asphalt tarmacs. Key visual challenges include wing reflections, shadow displacement depending on solar elevation angle, and partial occlusion near hangars or maintenance bays.

ship.title: Ship Category Profile
ship.description: Marine vessels ranging from small personal watercraft and fishing boats to large cargo container ships, tankers, and naval destroyers.
ship.key_characteristics: Ships exhibit elongated hydro-dynamic hull geometries, distinct bow and stern profiles, and recognizable wake patterns when in motion across water bodies.
ship.tactical_and_operational_context: Maritime vessel monitoring is essential for port congestion monitoring, trade route analytics, fisheries surveillance, and coastal security. Vessels in transit leave characteristic hydrodynamic wakes that assist speed estimation.
ship.detection_and_resolution_notes: Water surface reflections, wave crests, and sun glint often induce false positives. High-resolution synthetic aperture radar (SAR) or optical imagery allows distinguishing vessel types by hull length and beam width ratios.

storage-tank.title: Storage Tank Category Profile
storage-tank.description: Industrial cylindrical storage structures used for liquid fuel, petroleum products, chemicals, or water storage.
storage-tank.key_characteristics: Storage tanks appear as perfect circular structures in orthorectified aerial imagery. Fixed-roof tanks maintain constant circular shadows, whereas floating-roof tanks show varying internal shadows proportional to fill volume.
storage-tank.tactical_and_operational_context: Tank farms provide critical indicators for strategic energy reserves, refinery capacity, and industrial chemical manufacturing volume. Shadow analysis inside floating-roof tanks enables volumetric estimate modeling.
storage-tank.detection_and_resolution_notes: High circular symmetry makes storage tanks ideal targets for circular Hough transforms and oriented bounding box detectors. Color variations depend on roof coating (white, metallic, or dark primer).

baseball-diamond.title: Baseball Diamond Category Profile
baseball-diamond.description: Outdoor sports field layout dedicated to baseball, featuring a distinct diamond infield and semicircular outfield dirt pattern.
baseball-diamond.key_characteristics: Distinguished by a 90-foot diamond dirt infield, pitcher's mound circle, foul lines forming a 90-degree right angle, and grass outfield perimeter.
baseball-diamond.tactical_and_operational_context: Baseball diamonds serve as recreational landmark identifiers in suburban and urban geographic profiling, assisting urban land-use classification and municipal park mapping.
baseball-diamond.detection_and_resolution_notes: Highly recognizable due to high contrast between reddish-brown infield dirt and green turf grass. Scale remains highly standardized across high school, college, and professional facilities.

tennis-court.title: Tennis Court Category Profile
tennis-court.description: Rectangular sports court designed for single or double tennis matches.
tennis-court.key_characteristics: Standardized rectangular geometry (78 feet by 36 feet for doubles) with clearly marked white boundary lines, center net line, service boxes, and surrounding apron area.
tennis-court.tactical_and_operational_context: Tennis courts appear frequently in clusters near country clubs, resorts, academic institutions, and residential complexes, serving as indicators of recreational facilities.
tennis-court.detection_and_resolution_notes: Surfaces vary in color (hard court blue/green, clay red, grass green). Crisp geometric line patterns provide strong features for high-resolution optical edge detection algorithms.

basketball-court.title: Basketball Court Category Profile
basketball-court.description: Rectangular hard-surface playing area for basketball, located outdoors in parks, schools, or community centers.
basketball-court.key_characteristics: Rectangular boundary markings, key areas (paint), free-throw circles, three-point arcs, and visible hoop backboard structures at opposing ends.
basketball-court.tactical_and_operational_context: Outdoor basketball courts represent key social infrastructure landmarks in municipal zoning and urban community planning assessments.
basketball-court.detection_and_resolution_notes: Courts are frequently painted in high-contrast vibrant colors (blue, red, green, grey). Often adjacent to educational facilities or public housing developments.

ground-track-field.title: Ground Track Field Category Profile
ground-track-field.description: Large oval running track surrounding an interior grass field used for track and field athletics and soccer/football matches.
ground-track-field.key_characteristics: Classic 400-meter oval geometry with rounded semicircular ends, multiple parallel lane markings, and an inner field rectangle.
ground-track-field.tactical_and_operational_context: Ground track fields serve as large geographic orientation anchors in remote sensing images due to their size (approx 180m x 90m overall footprint).
ground-track-field.detection_and_resolution_notes: Track surfaces typically consist of red, blue, or tan synthetic rubber materials surrounding green turf, creating unmistakable oval color rings in satellite imagery.

harbor.title: Harbor Category Profile
harbor.description: Coastal port facility including docks, piers, breakwaters, quays, and mooring slips for vessel docking.
harbor.key_characteristics: Linear concrete or stone structures extending from land into water bodies, create finger-like piers and protected basins.
harbor.tactical_and_operational_context: Harbors are strategic transportation hubs facilitating maritime trade, cargo container transfer, and naval operations. Docking capacity correlates directly with port logistics volume.
harbor.detection_and_resolution_notes: Harbor detection involves complex land-water boundary segmentation and oriented box fitting along narrow pier structures.

bridge.title: Bridge Category Profile
bridge.description: Transportation superstructure spanning rivers, bays, valleys, or highway intersections to carry vehicle or rail traffic.
bridge.key_characteristics: Linear structure elevated over water or lower roadways, flanked by approach ramps, support piers, and casting distinct shadows onto the surface below.
bridge.tactical_and_operational_context: Bridges represent critical chokepoints in transportation networks. Tracking bridge integrity and traffic density is key for route planning and supply chain analytics.
bridge.detection_and_resolution_notes: High aspect-ratio rectangular bounding boxes are typical. Shadow patterns cast on water or ground provide strong spatial clues for height and span calculation.

large-vehicle.title: Large Vehicle Category Profile
large-vehicle.description: Heavy road vehicles including freight trucks, tractor-trailers, buses, construction haulers, and recreational vehicles.
large-vehicle.key_characteristics: Rectangular footprint significantly larger than standard passenger cars (typically 8m to 18m length), boxy cabin/trailer contours, and casting rectangular shadows.
large-vehicle.tactical_and_operational_context: Large vehicle counts on highways, logistics hubs, and industrial yards indicate commercial freight movement and economic activity levels.
large-vehicle.detection_and_resolution_notes: Orientation is aligned with road lanes or parking bay lines. High spatial resolution (<0.5m/pixel) is essential to distinguish trailers from static container boxes.

small-vehicle.title: Small Vehicle Category Profile
small-vehicle.description: Personal motorized passenger vehicles including sedan cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, vans, and minivans.
small-vehicle.key_characteristics: Compact rectangular geometry (approx 4m to 5m length by 1.8m width), sloped windshield reflections, and subtle shadow lines.
small-vehicle.tactical_and_operational_context: Small vehicle density indicates urban traffic flow, parking lot occupancy rates, commercial shopping traffic, and commuter patterns.
small-vehicle.detection_and_resolution_notes: Due to small pixel footprint in aerial images (e.g. 10x20 pixels), small vehicles require high feature map resolution and sub-pixel box regression.

helicopter.title: Helicopter Category Profile
helicopter.description: Rotary-wing aircraft capable of vertical takeoff and landing, hovering, and low-speed aerial movement.
helicopter.key_characteristics: Central compact fuselage, narrow tail boom, and circular rotor blade disc outline (if blades are spinning or static rotor lines).
helicopter.tactical_and_operational_context: Helicopters are utilized for emergency medical evacuation, law enforcement, offshore transport, and rapid tactical military insertion.
helicopter.detection_and_resolution_notes: Often located on helipads marked with an 'H' or on airfield aprons near fixed-wing aircraft. Lower frequency in generic datasets makes helicopter a rare class.

roundabout.title: Roundabout Category Profile
roundabout.description: Circular road junction where traffic flows continuously in one direction around a central island.
roundabout.key_characteristics: Circular island (grass, paved, or decorated center) surrounded by a continuous multi-lane ring roadway with radiating entry and exit arms.
roundabout.tactical_and_operational_context: Roundabouts manage traffic flow at major arterial intersections without traffic signals, serving as key urban road topology nodes.
roundabout.detection_and_resolution_notes: Easily identified by central circular geometry and radial road geometry. Radial symmetry assists orientation estimation.

soccer-ball-field.title: Soccer Ball Field Category Profile
soccer-ball-field.description: Rectangular grass or artificial turf field designated for soccer matches.
soccer-ball-field.key_characteristics: Rectangular turf layout (100m-110m length by 64m-75m width) with white perimeter touchlines, center line with center circle, penalty box rectangles, and goal posts.
soccer-ball-field.tactical_and_operational_context: Soccer fields are prominent municipal and educational athletic facilities, serving as landmark features in urban spatial planning.
soccer-ball-field.detection_and_resolution_notes: Green grass color coupled with distinct inner white line box markings provides robust multi-spectral optical signatures.

swimming-pool.title: Swimming Pool Category Profile
swimming-pool.description: Water-filled basin structure used for swimming and recreation, located in residential backyards, hotels, or sports complexes.
swimming-pool.key_characteristics: Rectangular, oval, or kidney-shaped basins filled with clear water, exhibiting bright blue or turquoise cyan hues surrounded by paved coping decks.
swimming-pool.tactical_and_operational_context: Residential swimming pool counts correlate with property valuation, suburban development density, and local water consumption modeling.
swimming-pool.detection_and_resolution_notes: Strong spectral signature due to water absorption and blue tile reflections. Small to medium spatial footprint requiring crisp color channel features.
